name: Smart Alarm Maxi
author: buildwithnoknok
description: A bedside lamp that wakes you up gently. Two alarms, armed with one press of the button, six alarm tones (from a soft chime to Mozart and an 8-bit jingle), and a wake-up light that brightens like a sunrise before the alarm rings. The display shows the time and can be turned to fit however you mount it. The knob sets brightness and colour, a double press starts a sundown fade for falling asleep.
assembly_guide: Connect the USB LEDs 16x module to the PicoHub's USB port.
Connect the LED Button, the Knob, the Buzzer and the Display to the PicoHub I2C ports.
Run setup in the noknok app, then pick your time zone on the lamp's settings page.
If the display is upside down or sideways in your housing, turn it under Display direction (or in the lamp's menu: Display).

controls.action: Arm the alarms: Alarm 1, Alarm 2, both, off (1, 2 or 3 short beeps; a low beep = off)
Sundown: the lamp fades gently to off over the sundown time, then the display dims for the night
Dark. Shows a new colour for 3 s after you change it
Brightness, or colour after a tap. The framed bar on the display shows which
Switch the knob between brightness and colour (back to brightness after 5 s)
Menu: Timer, Alarm 1, Alarm 2, Tone, Sundown, Display, Info (WiFi, IP, memory), Reset. Turn to choose, tap = OK, button = one step back, hold the knob to leave
Button press = stop the timer / snooze the alarm 5 min. Hold the button = stop the alarm. A press while snoozed cancels the snooze
Factory reset: keep holding until the LED flashes, goes dark and the buzzer sounds (about 8 s)
